overview.summary: Kuua’s history is the story of Dranik rise and Muramite conquest, with Discord energy tearing the world open.

timeline.name: Age of Dranik
timeline.description: The Dranik peoples flourish across Kuua, building fortified cities, causeways, and citadels. Their culture blends martial discipline with arcane warding against external planar threats.

timeline.name: First Discord Incursions
timeline.description: Discord rifts begin to appear in remote regions. Early Dranik defenders and scholars attempt to study and contain the anomalies, unaware of the Muramite Legion gathering beyond the veil.

timeline.name: Muramite Invasion
timeline.description: The Muramite Legion launches a full-scale invasion through stabilized Discord portals. Dranik strongholds fall one by one, and Kuua’s geography is reshaped into warfronts and proving grounds.

timeline.name: Occupation and Experimentation
timeline.description: Under Muramite control, Kuua becomes a laboratory for Discord energy and temporal manipulation. Proving Grounds, ritual chambers, and citadel complexes are erected to test mortals and refine war magic.

timeline.name: Current Era
timeline.description: Riftseekers and scattered Dranik survivors fight a quiet war against the Legion’s dominance. Temporal fractures leave echoes of past battles and future catastrophes, making Kuua a world where history and destiny overlap.

key_events.name: Fall of Dranik
key_events.description: The Ruined City of Dranik becomes the symbol of Kuua’s collapse, its walls shattered by Muramite siege engines and Discord storms.

key_events.name: Ignition of Dranik Scar
key_events.description: A catastrophic planar rupture creates the Dranik Scar, a vast wound in the world where Discord energy pours into Kuua and spawns aberrant life.

key_events.name: Riftseekers’ Intervention
key_events.description: Riftseekers establish sanctums to stabilize rifts and anchor time, creating fragile pockets of relative safety amid the chaos.
